quotes.text: • Altri motivi familiari (ad esempio si occupa della casa, è in attesa di un figlio, vuole più tempo per la famiglia)
• Altri motivi familiari (ad esempio fa la casalinga/o, in attesa di un figlio, vuole più tempo per la famiglia)

assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire mentions domestic work ('si occupa della casa', 'casalinga/o') only as a response category for working part-time (e.g., QC29), as a reason for not seeking work (e.g., QF07), or as a self-perceived status of inactivity (e.g., QJ01). It does not contain dedicated questions measuring domestic work for each household member separately from main and secondary employment. Therefore, domestic work is treated as a category of inactivity or a reason for not working rather than recorded in its own dedicated questions.
